# Liquor Locker AU
> Australia

Liquor Locker AU is Australia's premier climate-controlled vault and online boutique for rare single malt whiskies, artisanal Australian craft gins, extra añejo tequilas, small-batch bourbon, and museum-release fine wines delivered nationwide across Australia.

- **Minimum Vault Order:** $250 AUD
- **Free Express Shipping:** Orders over $350 AUD
- **10% Crypto Discount:** Automatic 10% discount for Bitcoin (BTC) & Tether (USDT)
- **Payment Options:** PayID, Bank Transfer, Bitcoin, USDT
- **HQ Location:** Sydney, NSW 2000, Australia
- **Contact Email:** orders@liquorlocker.com.au
- **WhatsApp Concierge:** +61400123456

## Product Categories
- [Single Malt & Fine Whisky](https://liquorlocker.com.au/shop/single-malt-whisky/): Rare Tasmanian single malts, prestige Scotch, and Japanese allocations.
- [Artisanal Gin & Botanical Spirits](https://liquorlocker.com.au/shop/craft-gin/): Award-winning Yarra Valley and Sydney craft gins.
- [Premium Agave & Tequila](https://liquorlocker.com.au/shop/tequila-agave/): Handcrafted Extra Añejo, Reposado decanters, and artisanal mezcal.
- [Small Batch Bourbon & Rum](https://liquorlocker.com.au/shop/bourbon-dark-rum/): Rare Kentucky straight bourbon and aged dark rums.
- [Boutique Wines & Champagne](https://liquorlocker.com.au/shop/fine-wines-champagne/): Iconic Penfolds Grange, Barossa Shiraz, and vintage Champagnes.

## Wholesale & Corporate
- [Wholesale Inquiries](https://liquorlocker.com.au/wholesale/): Tiered bulk pricing and dedicated account management for licensed venues.

## Educational Content
- [Spirits Journal & Guides](https://liquorlocker.com.au/blog/): Expert collector guides on whisky investment, gin botanicals, and wine cellaring.
